I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the 2027 Thornbury Cloth Co. renewal is 166 seats.

That number comes from the brain's saved messages. On Oct 14 Ilse posted 163 in #north-team, then corrected it later that day in #north-random, saying Thornbury's ops lead had told her it was 166. Dana is in both channels, so she could see both messages herself. A seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it can be shared with her team.

I couldn't find either of Ilse's posts when I read the two channels directly; they only turned up in the brain. I also found no Thornbury account files in the shared folders.
